key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as bond yields climb, pressuring equity valuations
AUD 'trapdoor opens' amid RBA hawkish stance despite surging unemployment
RBA signals continued hikes despite unemployment spike, creating an interest-rate pincer for households
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; more than half of renters financially stressed
Gold and small-cap miners (Anax, Many Peaks, MinRex, Micro-X, Arrow, Mamba, Aurum, Zenith) outperform in risk-off environment
$2.7B cap-raise torrent keeps ASX brokers active, signalling capital-hungry small caps
Data centre boom strains energy supply, creating headwinds for energy sector
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/entertainment names
Victoria flagged as 'the unemployment state' ahead of looming election
Global AI/semiconductor momentum (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Lumentum) continues but ASX tech exposure remains thin

sectors.trend: Gold miners and junior explorers (Anax, Many Peaks, MinRex, Micro-X, Arrow, Mamba, Aurum, Zenith, Kuniko) lead gains as safe-haven flows and AUD weakness boost commodity-linked equities. Large-cap iron ore/coal names (BHP, RIO, FMG) under pressure from global risk-off and China policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: Rotation into gold and base-metal juniors; large-cap miners face margin pressure if AUD stays weak and China demand softens. Cap-raise activity ($2.7B) signals dilution risk for small caps.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish pivot despite unemployment surge widens net interest margins but raises credit-loss concerns. Renters' financial stress and property price declines threaten mortgage book quality. Star casino licence suspension hits gaming-linked revenue.
sectors.implications: CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC benefit from higher rates short-term but face NPL pressure within 6–12 months. Property-linked lending (REITs, residential) is the key vulnerability.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creates structural energy demand but 'energy bust' risk from grid constraints and permitting delays (AI data centre built without permit). Energy security becomes a policy priority.
sectors.implications: Energy names (SAP, WES, AGL) face demand tailwinds but regulatory and infrastructure bottlenecks cap near-term upside. LNG exporters benefit from global supply tightness.

sectors.trend: Card surcharge phase-out shifts payment flows; consumer spending under pressure from interest-rate pincer and renter stress. Fast-food beverage innovation (Pickle Pepsis) signals defensive consumer positioning.
sectors.implications: WES, WOW, CSL face margin pressure from input costs and weak discretionary spend. Staples outperform cyclicals.

sectors.trend: Global AI/semiconductor momentum (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Lumentum, Zscaler) strong but ASX tech exposure minimal. Domestic AI adoption in small business and data centres is early-stage.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX beneficiaries; indirect exposure via energy (power demand) and infrastructure (data centre construction). Monitor for ASX-listed AI plays.

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to 40-year decline; CBD commercial tower listed at $40m; Dusty Martin portfolio haircut. Renter stress at 50%+ signals tenant default risk.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW, ICOL, DGL) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Residential mortgage-backed assets under stress.

key_themes: RBA rate pincer: hiking into a labour-market deterioration
AUD weakness as a structural headwind for importers and large-cap miners
Gold and junior miners as relative outperformers in risk-off tape
Property market correction accelerating across residential and commercial
Data centre energy demand vs. grid/permitting constraints
Immigration policy debate impacting labour supply and housing demand
Global AI/semiconductor cycle strong but ASX under-exposed

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hiking into recession / unemployment spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (CSL, WES); underweight rate-sensitive growth and property REITs. Monitor RBA statement for pivot language.
Favour exporters and gold miners (AUD hedge); avoid import-heavy consumer names. Consider AUD short via FX if portfolio is AUD-denominated.
Reduce residential REIT and bank exposure; monitor NPL data. Shift to infrastructure and healthcare REITs.
Avoid pre-announcement small-cap positions; favour fully-funded juniors with near-term catalysts (Aurum, Zenith).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre boom
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor energy policy; favour integrated energy majors (SAP, WES) over pure-play renewables exposed to grid delays.
Diversify away from China-revenue-concentrated miners; monitor iron ore and LNG pricing.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and base-metal juniors with funded drill programmes
opportunities.rationale: AUD weakness, risk-off flows, and strong assay results (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 hits) support relative outperformance

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Interest-rate pincer and unemployment spike favour non-cyclical, dividend-paying names with pricing power

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure via integrated majors
opportunities.rationale: Data centre demand creates structural tailwind; grid constraints favour companies with own generation capacity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential property REIT and bank exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline, 50%+ renter stress, and rising NPLs threaten credit quality and occupancy

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD via gold and commodity-linked equities
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' open; gold miners provide natural currency hedge and benefit from safe-haven demand
$2.7B weekly cap-raise volume signals dilution risk; many juniors lack funding runway

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend losses in 5th week as bond yields stay elevated and RBA maintains hawkish bias. Gold miners and defensives lead; banks and property REITs lag. AUD remains under pressure. Volatility elevated ahead of Victoria election and RBA meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: if unemployment continues rising, RBA forced to pivot, supporting equities. Property correction may deepen before stabilising. Gold and energy remain structural themes. AI/data centre capex provides medium-term infrastructure demand. Key risk is a hard landing in China dragging commodity prices.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement language
Australian unemployment and CPI data releases
Victoria state election outcome and policy signals
AUD/USD trajectory and RBA intervention risk
Iron ore and LNG pricing (China demand)
Data centre energy policy and grid investment announcements
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Australian NPL data and bank credit conditions
China PMI and property sector policy
US 10Y yield and global bond market stress
